main.description: Store one owner-queue item in a desk's queue. The caller must be the desk or the item's author. Ingest is idempotent by uri: the same uri and cid returns the stored seq with stored false; the same uri with another cid is refused and logged. An item naming a project other than the desk's bound project is refused.

errors.name: CidInvalid
errors.description: cid is not the content hash of the item.

errors.name: CidConflict
errors.description: The desk already holds this uri with another cid.

errors.name: ProjectMismatch
errors.description: The item names a project other than the desk's.
